newsitem.title: UK: Hitachi Credit posts premium on LSE debut.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi Credit posts premium on LSE debut.

text.p: Shares in credit finance company Hitachi Credit(UK) Plc (HCUK) on Tuesday crept to a 5.6 percent premium on their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange, dealers said.
HCUK shares, issued at 135p, rose 7-1/2p to 142-1/2p by 0959 GMT in volume of 236,000 shares.
The company, previously a wholly-owned subsidiary of Hitachi Credit Corporation of Japan, raised around 20 million stg from its flotation, which valued HCUK at about 57.3 million stg.

HCUK said the float would strengthen the balance sheet by reducing gearing and would provide a more solid platform from which to expand the company's businesses through organic growth and acquisitions.
The company offers a range of financial products to both business and personal sectors in the UK.
